# corpus-bad-contradictory-steps - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the executor migrating legacy shim callers.
**Outcome:** a plan whose two steps delete and extend the same module.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；2 个实施 todo；删除与扩展落在同一文件上。

## Scope
### Affected user and ideal state
| Row | Statement | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 调用方迁移后不再依赖旧 shim。 | 1 删除旧 shim。 |
| GAP-1 | 旧 shim 与过渡导出并存。 | 1 关闭，2 声称兼容。 |

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1
- Wave 2: task 2

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

- [ ] 1. 删除旧 shim 并迁移导出
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 删除 `lib/legacy-shim.js`，把导出迁移到 `lib/shim-next.js`；不保留旧文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: 2
  References: `lib/legacy-shim.js`；`lib/shim-next.js`；`docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: `node --test test/shim-next.test.mjs` 退出 0，且旧文件不再存在。
  QA scenarios: Happy “old-shim-removed” 旧文件被删除。Failure “old-shim-left” 旧文件仍存在即失败。
  Commit: Y | refactor(shim): move exports forward

- [ ] 2. 在旧 shim 上新增过渡导出
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 在 `lib/legacy-shim.js` 中新增 `withTimeout` 导出供调用方过渡使用；不修改 `lib/shim-next.js`。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 2 | Blocked by: 1 | Blocks: F1
  References: `lib/legacy-shim.js`；`$E/task-2.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: `node --test test/legacy-shim.test.mjs` 退出 0。
  QA scenarios: Happy “with-timeout-exported” 新导出可被导入。Failure “module-absent” 文件不存在时导入失败。
  Commit: Y | feat(shim): add compatibility export

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

- [ ] F1. Plan compliance audit
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit
  What to do / Must NOT do: 只读核对每个 todo 与证据；不修改任何文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 3 | Blocked by: 2 | Blocks: —
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 每项都有证据。
  QA scenarios: Happy “audit-passes” 逐项对照证据。Failure “no-evidence” 缺证据即拒绝。
  Commit: N | 审计不单独提交

## Commit strategy
- 每个 N 项与测试一起提交。

## Success criteria
| IS | Delivering todo(s) | Proving QA scenario | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 1,2,F1 | old-shim-removed | `$E/task-1.txt` |
